categories.main_business_segments: Hangzhou Alltest Biotech Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the in vitro diagnostics (IVD) industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of rapid diagnostic reagents. Its product portfolio includes six major series: drug and substance abuse detection, infectious disease detection, women's health detection, tumor marker detection, cardiac marker detection, and other diagnostic tests. The company also produces biochemical diagnostic reagents, molecular diagnostics, and electronic diagnostic instruments.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed eight core technology platforms including biological raw materials, POCT rapid diagnostic technology, biochemical technology, chemiluminescence technology, electronic instruments, immunoblotting, molecular diagnostics, and biosensor electrochemical technology. Key proprietary technologies include monoclonal antibody preparation, nano-scale immunogold labeling, time-resolved immunofluorescence, dry chemistry analysis, and electrochemical biosensors. These technologies support the production of over 1,400 diagnostic reagent products and enable monthly new product launches.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Alltest serves a diverse customer base including hospitals, pharmacies, national laboratories, law enforcement, military, and customs agencies globally. Its products are widely used in clinical diagnostics, on-site testing, personal health management, and veterinary diagnostics. The company’s overseas sales dominate, with products sold in over 170 countries and regions, targeting both high-end markets in Europe and the Americas and emerging markets in Asia and beyond.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with a strong presence in over 170 countries and regions. Key markets include Europe, North America, Asia, and Oceania. It has subsidiaries and branches in China, the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, Spain, and Hong Kong, supporting its international sales and regulatory registrations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Alltest operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the IVD supply chain, focusing on the development, manufacturing, and sales of diagnostic reagents and instruments. It has vertically integrated capabilities in producing core biological raw materials such as antigens and antibodies, achieving over 80% self-supply rate, reducing reliance on upstream suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth with significant R&D investment (11.06% of revenue in 2024). Strategic priorities include expanding POCT technology, developing new diagnostic reagents, enhancing biological raw material platforms, and integrating AI and digital health technologies. It aims to maintain monthly new product launches, broaden product lines, and strengthen global regulatory certifications including FDA, CE, IVDR, and others.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of diagnostic reagents and related instruments. The company employs an ODM (Original Design Manufacturer) model for overseas sales, complemented by sales under its own brands domestically and internationally. Revenue streams include product sales to medical institutions, government agencies, and commercial customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Alltest is positioned as a leading supplier in the global POCT segment of the IVD industry, competing with international giants like Roche, Abbott, Danaher, and Siemens in certain product categories. It holds a competitive edge in drug abuse and infectious disease testing with globally leading products and a broad product portfolio. The company leverages its proprietary technologies and extensive regulatory certifications to maintain and expand its market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Alltest reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 866.6 million, a 14.83% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 302.5 million, up 67.5%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 4.19 billion with net assets of RMB 3.88 billion. It has demonstrated strong cash flow generation and maintains a stable growth trajectory supported by expanding overseas sales and continuous product innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Alltest differentiates itself through a comprehensive product portfolio exceeding 1,400 types, rapid innovation cycles with monthly new product launches, and strong proprietary technology platforms enabling high-quality, cost-effective diagnostics. Its self-developed biological raw materials reduce costs and improve product stability. The company’s global regulatory certifications and extensive international market penetration provide customers with reliable, accurate, and diverse diagnostic solutions tailored to clinical, on-site, and personal health needs.
